title: Let grace settle what you cannot
summary: The line returns the soul to received mercy before self-audit or strain can take over. Keep this close: Remember this: received forgiveness becomes lasting peace when it ripens into Naam.
takeaway: Receive grace before reviewing yourself again.
lifeApplication: When effort turns harsh, stop, breathe, and ask what mercy is already doing that strain cannot.

source.shortMeaning: Grace settles what effort alone keeps stirring up.
source.lifeApplication: When strain fails, pause and ask what grace is already offering.
